item.title: Daily Minute — September 10, 2026
item.description: Let no dark cloud out of YOUR past obscure him from you, for truth lies ONLY in the present, and you will find it if you seek it there. You have looked for it where it is NOT, and therefore have not found it. Learn, then, to seek it where it IS, and it will dawn on eyes that see. Your past was made in anger, and if you use it to attack the present you will not SEE the freedom that the present hold

item.title: Lesson 88: Today we will review these ideas:
item.description: Today we will review these ideas: [75] “The light has come.” In choosing salvation rather than attack, I merely choose to recognize what is already here. Salvation is a decision made already. Attack and grievances are not there to choose.That is why I always choose between truth and illusion; between what is there and what is not. The light has come. I can but choose the light, for it has no alter
